    • addToGraph

      public void addToGraph(StateGraph<AgentExecutorEx.State> graph) throws GraphStateException
      Registers the sub-agent as a node in the parent graph and adapts tool execution requests to the sub-agent message format.

      Before invoking the sub-graph, the pending tool call arguments are wrapped as a UserMessage. After completion, the last sub-agent message is converted back into a ToolResponseMessage associated with the original tool call id.

      Specified by:
      addToGraph in interface AgentEx.ToolBehaviour<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message,AgentExecutorEx.State>
      Parameters:
      graph - the parent graph receiving this sub-agent node
      Throws:
      GraphStateException - if graph node registration fails
